user.title: Ollama server
user.description: ParentControl rates running YouTube videos with a local Ollama model and pauses unsuitable ones. Afterwards each device gets switches for jumping to the start, educational value, swear words, and strict rating.

settings.title: Set up the check
settings.description: The rating comes from a language model and is not an official age rating.

error.cannot_connect: The Ollama server cannot be reached.
error.no_models: No model is installed on the Ollama server.
error.no_players: Select at least one media player.

ages.title: Own age per device
ages.description: Leave empty to use the default age.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: An empty field restores the default text. After a change, videos are checked again.

lists.title: Channel lists for all devices
lists.description: One channel per line. For allowed channels, add the minimum age after a semicolon, for example: Die Maus; 0

device_lists.title: Channel lists for {device}
device_lists.description: Applies on top of the global lists. The device entry comes first, and a block always wins.

error.no_players: Select at least one media player.
error.invalid_age: The allowed list contains an invalid age. Use 0 to 18.

strict.name: Strict rating (block without subtitles or result)

allow_channel.name: Allow channel
allow_channel.description: Adds a channel to the allowed list and removes it from the blocked list.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel name. Empty uses the channel running on the media player.

player.name: Media player
player.description: Provides the running channel and the device for the device list.

only_this_device.name: Only this device
only_this_device.description: Adds the channel to the device list instead of the global list.

age.name: Age
age.description: The channel is allowed from this age.
